name: haul-book
description: Haul Book monorepo root — metadata only. Development is docker-first (see Makefile + docker-compose.yml): no npm/node ever runs on the host, and this root package has no dependencies or scripts. The real packages are packages/shared, apps/api, and apps/web — standalone npm packages (no workspaces), each with its own package.json + package-lock.json installed in-container via npm ci.
